blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) pretrained exclusively on public data that sets a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size: on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin Clean2Rand and RoboCasa365, it is outperformed only by models about twice its size. REKI consists of a vision-language model (VLM) followed by a flow-matching action expert, and is pretrained on a curated mixture of public robot, egocentric human and vision-language data. Additionally, we endow it with a memory that gives the policy access to its recent past at negligible cost: a few register tokens in the action expert summarise the output of the VLM at each frame and persist in the expert's cache. This memory improves success in simulation and on real robots, and makes oscillations between poses about four times rarer. REKI uses a simple model design and training paradigm, and is optimised to be efficient at training and inference. We release the full code across data curation, training, inference and evaluation, deployment, and all pretrained and finetuned model weights: https://github.com/kyutai-labs/reki.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了REKI,一种2.4B的视觉语言动作模型(VLA)在公共数据上预作训练,设定了新的Pareto在性能和模型大小之间的边框:在LIBERO-Plus,RoboTwin Clean2Rand和RoboCasa365上,其性能仅被大约两倍于其大小的模型所超越. REKI由一个视觉语言模型(VLM)组成,后由流相相动作专家组成,并被预训于由公共机器人,以自负为中心的人和视觉语言数据等被曲相混合而成. 此外,我们赋予它一种记忆,使政策能够以可忽略不计的代价了解其最近的历史:行动专家中的几个登记标志概括了每个框架的VLM产出,并一直停留在专家的缓存中。 这种内存提高了模拟和在真机器人上的成功度,使姿势之间的振荡度大约是罕见的四倍. REKI使用简单的模型设计和培训范式,并被优化为在培训和推论上高效. 我们公布完整的代码,包括数据整理、培训、推论和评价、部署,以及所有经过预先训练和微调的模型权重:https://github.com/kyutai-labs/reki。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have become an effective paradigm for language-conditioned robot control.
A pretrained vision–language model (VLM) encodes camera views and instruction, based on which a smaller action expert predicts the next actions ( Black et al., 2024 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Shukor et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
视觉-语言-动作模型(VLAs)已成为语言条件机器人控制的有效范例.
预先训练的视觉-语言模型(VLM)编码相机视图和指示,根据这个模型,一个较小的动作专家预测接下来的行动(Black等,2024;物理智能等,2025;Bjorck等,2025;Shukor等,2025;Yuan等,2026;Ma等,2026)。

blocks.en:
The strongest VLAs today are pretrained partly on proprietary data, and neither these data nor the pretraining pipelines are released ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) , making it hard to reproduce their results. Since each new model changes architecture, data and training recipe at once, gains cannot be traced back to a single choice.
With REKI, we release the full pipeline, from data curation to deployment.
REKI has a simple design, is pretrained on public data only and sets a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size.
It pairs a VLM with a flow-matching action expert, and a memory mechanism gives the policy access to its recent past.
blocks.zh:
当今最强的VLA部分是专有数据预作训练,这些数据和预作训练的管线都没有被放出(物理情报等,2025;袁等,2026),使得其结果难以再现. 由于每个新模式同时改变结构、数据和培训方法,收益无法追溯到单一的选择。
随着REKI,我们释放了整个管道,从数据整理到部署.
REKI有一个简单的设计,只在公共数据上预先训练,并在性能和模型大小之间设置了一个新的Pareto边框.
它将VLM与流相匹配动作专家配对,而内存机制则让政策进入其最近的历史.

blocks.en:
Preserving past context can improve control ( Octo Model Team et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Chi et al., 2025 ) , yet most VLAs predict actions from the current observation alone ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Shukor et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
Existing ways of incorporating such context, however, often introduce substantial overhead ( Fig. 2 ): feeding past frames to the VLM adds their image tokens to every VLM pass ( Jang et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) , recurrent methods require sequential training ( Cherepanov et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) , and others introduce additional, dedicated memory modules to the policy ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Koo et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
保留过去的背景可以改进控制(Octo Model Team等,第1段)。 ; 2024; 刘等; 2025; Chi等; 2025),然而大多数VLA预测单从目前的观测中采取行动(Kim等; 2024; Black等; 2024; 物理智能等; 2025; Bjorck等; 2025; Shukor等; 2025; Lee等; 2025; Qu等; 2025; 刘等; 2026).
然而,纳入这种背景的现有方法往往带来大量的间接费用(图2):向VLM喂食过去的帧会给每一次VLM通行证增加其图像符号(Jang等人,2025年;Yuan等人,2026年),经常性方法需要相继训练(Cherepanov等人,2026年;Jiang等人,2026年),而其他方法则在政策中引入了额外的专用记忆模块(Shi等人,2026年;Koo等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
REKI summarises past context through a small set of registers ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) in the action expert.
The registers of each frame are cached across chunks ( Fig. 3 ).
Each frame is thus encoded only once and no separate module, sequential unroll during training or test-time update mechanisms are necessary.
This yields clear gains at almost no overhead, and our 2.4B model REKI ranks first among VLAs pretrained on public data on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin Clean2Rand and RoboCasa365 ( Fig. 1 ), and generalises to real robots.
blocks.zh:
REKI通过行动专家的一套小登记册(Darcet等,2024年)总结了过去的情况。
每个框架的登记册分块缓存(图3)。
因此,每个框架只编码一次,不需要单独的模块,在培训或测试时间更新机制期间需要连续不滚动。

blocks.en:
Our ablations show that memory consistently improves performance, with the most pronounced gains for the first past frame ( Fig. 5 ).
Beyond task success, we find that memory stabilises action generation: without memory, the policy often oscillates between poses across action chunks, while with memory, such oscillations are about four times rarer ( Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的描述表明,记忆不断改善业绩,第一个过去框架(图5)取得了最显著的进展。
除了任务成功之外,我们发现记忆稳定动作生成:没有记忆,政策往往会振荡到跨动作块之间的摆放,而随着记忆,这种振荡大约是罕见的四倍(图5)。

blocks.en: Our contributions are thus three-fold : (i) We introduce REKI, a 2.4B-parameter VLA pretrained on public data, which sets a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size. (ii) We introduce register tokens in the action expert to act as a memory, which can be cached efficiently, and analyse how this reduces the failure modes of the memoryless policy. We hope REKI serves as a strong and accessible baseline for future VLA research. To foster VLA research, we release the model weights and our optimised training and inference code, from data curation to deployment on a real robot.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们的捐助有三个方面: (一) 我们引入了REKI,这是一个在公共数据上预先培训的2.4B参数VLA,它为性能和模型大小设定了一个新的Pareto边界. (二)我们在动作专家中引入了注册符以作为内存,可以高效地缓存,并分析这如何减少无记忆政策的失败模式. 我们希望REKI成为未来VLA研究的有力和可获得的基准. 为了培养VLA的研究,我们释放了模型重量 和优化的训练和推论代码, 从数据校正到部署在真正的机器人上。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Open pretraining. Many VLAs release their weights, and often their finetuning code, but not the code or the exact data mixture used for pretraining ( Physical Intelligence, 2025 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
The strongest VLAs are pretrained partly on proprietary data, collected ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) or synthesised ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , and several have no public weights ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) .
OpenVLA, Octo and RDT-1B released their full pipeline on public data such as Open X-Embodiment ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Octo Model Team et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , followed by SmolVLA, MolmoAct and MolmoAct2, which also releases bimanual data collected by its authors ( Shukor et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) .
These releases have helped the research community pretrain models again, change their data or design, and compare them under the same conditions.
Models pretrained on larger in-house data, with more recent design choices, have nonetheless kept a lead on most benchmarks.
Building on this line of work, REKI is pretrained on a broad mixture of public robot, egocentric human and vision–language data, and released in full, from data curation to deployment on a real robot.
It reaches the best results among VLAs pretrained on public data on three benchmarks ( Section 6.1 ), and is optimised for fast inference ( Section 6.3 ).
blocks.zh:
开放预训. 许多VLA释放出重量,并经常会微调出代码,但不包括用于预训的代码或精确数据混合物(物理智能,2025;Bjorck等,2025;刘等,2026;郑等,2025;陈等,2026).
最强的VLA部分被预先训练在专有数据上,收集(物理智能等,2025年;王等,2026年a;刘等,2026年)或合成(袁等,2026年),有数个没有公共权重(物理智能等,2026年;王等,2026年a;袁等,2026年).
OpenVLA,Octo和RDT-1B在Open X-Embodiment(Kim等,2024;Octo Model Team等,2024;Liu等,2025;SmolVLA,Molmo Act和Molmo Act2)等公共数据上发布了完整的管道,随后还发布了由作者收集的双人数据(Shukor等,2025;Lee等,2025;Fang等,2026).
这些发布帮助了研究界再次预演模型,改变其数据或设计,并在相同条件下进行比较.
模型预先在更大的内部数据上加以培训,并有较新的设计选择,但仍在大多数基准上保持领先地位。
在这项工作的基础上,REKI在公共机器人、以自我为中心的人和视觉语言数据的广泛组合上进行了预先培训,并从数据解析到部署在真正的机器人上。
它在志愿军中取得了最佳结果,预先根据三个基准(第6.1节)对公共数据进行了培训,并被优化为快速推断(第6.3节)。

blocks.en:
Memory in VLAs. Most of these models act on the current observation alone, yet past context helps a policy identify the task state and recover from failed attempts ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Torne et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) , and methods differ in where they pay for it ( Fig. 2 ).
The most direct approach stacks or compresses past frames in the VLM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Torne et al., 2026 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2026 ; Jang et al., 2025 ) .
Its cost then grows with the window, at least in the vision encoder ( Koo et al., 2026 ) .
A recurrent state ( Cherepanov et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) or fast weights ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) keep the input short, but must be unrolled step by step in training.
Others store past features or keyframes in an extra module ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Koo et al., 2026 ; Mark et al., 2026 ; Sridhar et al., 2026 ) .
Like μ \mu VLA and HAMLET, REKI carries the past in a few learnable tokens, but as registers ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) in the action expert.
The VLM encodes each frame once, a training window is one batched pass, and at inference memory adds under 1% to the prediction time of a model without memory ( K = 1 K\mkern 1.25mu{=}\mkern 1.25mu1 , Section A.1 ).
Without memory, a policy can also switch between modes at each new action chunk ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ; Lian et al., 2026 ) , which is attributed to perceptual aliasing in reinforcement learning ( Whitehead & Ballard, 1991 ; Singh et al., 1994 ; McCallum, 1996 ) .
In REKI, memory makes such switches about four times rarer ( Section 6.2 ), without the extra policy queries of temporal ensembling or bidirectional decoding ( Zhao et al., 2023b ; Liu et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh:
记忆在VLAs. 这些模型大多仅根据目前的观察行事,然而过去的背景有助于政策确定任务状态,并从失败的尝试中恢复(Shi等,2026;Torne等,2026;Gao等,2026),方法在支付时有所不同(图2)。
最直接的接近堆叠或压缩了VLM中的过去帧(袁等,2026;托恩等,2026;物理智能等,2026;张等,2025.).
其成本随窗户而增加,至少在视觉编码器中(Koo等,2026.).
反复出现的状态(Cherepanov等,2026;Xiao等,2026)或快重(Jiang等,2026)会保持输入的短暂性,但在训练中必须一步步地不滚动.
另一些则将过去的特性或键框存储在一个额外的模块中(Shi等,2026;Koo等,2026;Mark等,2026;Sridhar等,2026).
与μ\mu VLA和HAMLET一样,REKI以几个可学习的符号来承载过去,但在动作专家中作为注册(Darcet等,2024年).
VLM 编码每个帧一次,一个训练窗口是一个分批通过,推论一个模型没有内存的预测时间增加不到1%(K= 1 K\mkern) 1.25穆克恩语 1.25mu1, A.1节.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: How VLAs carry the past. Each panel shows one training window of three frames, with a loss under each frame that receives one. (a) Past frames enter the VLM with the current one, in full ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , compressed ( Torne et al., 2026 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2026 ) or from a cache ( Jang et al., 2025 ) .
The VLM takes the whole window as input, and only the last frame is supervised. (b) A state is written at each step and read at the next, in the backbone ( Cherepanov et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) or as fast weights in the head ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
Each step needs the output of the previous one, so the window is unrolled step by step. (c) Each frame is encoded on its own, and an added module mixes the memory tokens of past frames into the prediction for the current one.
HAMLET ( Koo et al., 2026 ) supervises the last frame only, and MemoryVLA ( Shi et al., 2026 ) every frame, with the bank entries stored without gradient. (d) In REKI, the memory tokens are registers in the action expert.
Their keys and values are kept across frames and read by the self-attention already present.
The window is one batched pass, and every frame receives a loss.

The action expert is conditioned on the camera observations, the text instruction and the robot state, through two separate paths.

Encoded context. Following recent practice ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , 𝑬 t \bm{E}_{t} is the final-layer hidden states of a VLM, read by cross-attention.
This keeps the encoder and the action expert independent, and is reported to match or outperform alternatives such as processing the encoded context jointly with the noisy chunk by self-attention ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , or attending the backbone at single or all layers ( Black et al., 2024 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Shukor et al., 2025 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ) .
We use Qwen3.5-2B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and pack the prompt and the camera views into a single stream (Appendix Fig. 9 ).
The prompt z t z_{t} carries the language instruction, the embodiment, the control mode, the control frequency and a binned episode length ( Appendix A ).
The embodiment, control-frequency and episode-length fields are dropped with probability 0.15, 0.2 and 0.2 during training.

blocks.en: Building on the policy of Section 3 , REKI gives the action expert a memory of prior frames through registers ( Section 4.1 ), which are trained end to end with the flow-matching objective and cached at inference ( Section 4.2 ).

blocks.en:
Standard VLAs condition on the current context c t c_{t} alone.
We give the expert access to the preceding frames through n r n_{r} memory tokens per frame, implemented as registers ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) .
The registers of frame t t cross-attend the encoded prompt and views of that frame, self-attend the registers of the earlier frames, and persist as keys and values in the expert’s cache, implemented as a rolling window over the K − 1 K-1 preceding frames with K = 3 K\mkern 1.25mu{=}\mkern 1.25mu3 ( Section 4.2 ).
Since they do not attend the action tokens and skip the adaptive normalisation, they depend only on the observations and can be shared across frames and denoising steps.

At the start of an episode, a window holds fewer frames.

blocks.en:
Multi-draw variance reduction. The loss of Eq. 2 is an expectation over the flow time and the noise, and a single ( τ , ϵ ) (\tau,\bm{\epsilon}) draw per frame gives a noisy estimate of it.
An extra draw costs one pass of the expert, whereas the context and the registers it reads cost one pass of the encoder, which dominates the cost of a training step.
As in Yuan et al. (2026) and Allshire et al. (2026) , we therefore estimate the expectation from eight independent draws per frame.
The eight noisy chunks share the encoded context and the registers of their frame, so the encoder runs once for all of them.
The registers of frame s s thus receive gradient from the eight draws of every frame from s s to K K .

多拓宽差异减小. Eq. 2的丢失是对流出时间和噪声的期待,而一幅单相 (\ tau,\bm\epsilon}) 每帧取出一幅画给出了响亮的估计.
额外抽取要花费专家的一次通行证,而其上下文和登记册则要花费编码器的一次通行证,这在培训阶段的费用中占主导地位。
与袁等(2026年)和阿勒希尔等(2026年)一样,我们因此估计期望从每帧八道独立取出.
八个吵闹的块共用了被编码的上下文和它们的帧的登记簿,所以编码器为它们全部运行一次.
框 s 的登记册因此从 s 至 K K 的每个框的八取得到梯度。

blocks.en:
Implementation. The frames of a window are packed into a single batch and kept independent in the backbone by cu_seqlens boundaries.
In the expert, the self-attention of Eq. 5 is computed by one variable-length FlashAttention call.
For this, the keys and values that each group of queries reads are gathered into one sequence: the register tokens 𝑴 1 : t \bm{M}_{1:t} for the registers of frame t t , and 𝑴 1 : t \bm{M}_{1:t} followed by the action tokens of one noisy chunk for the queries of that chunk (Appendix Fig. 9(b) ).

为此,每组查询读取的密钥和值被集合成一个序列:用于帧t t 的注册的寄存符M 1: t\bm{M}_{1:t},以及用于该块查询的M 1: t\bm{M}_{1:t},然后是用于该块查询的一个吵闹块的动作符(附录图9(b)).

blocks.en:
Inference. At inference, each frame needs one encoder pass over the current observation and ten Euler steps on the action tokens.
The registers do not read the action tokens and skip adaptive normalisation ( Section 4.1 ), so neither they nor the context depend on the flow time τ \tau or on the state.
The registers of the current frame are thus computed together with the action tokens in the first Euler step, and their keys and values are reused at the nine others.
The register keys and values are also kept for the frames that follow, ( K − 1 ) ​ n r (K-1)\,n_{r} pairs per expert block.
The cache is a rolling window, so the registers of the oldest frame are dropped when those of a new frame enter (Appendix Fig. 10 ).
At training, each window of K K frames is processed in isolation.
At inference, the cached registers were themselves computed with the registers of earlier frames, so information can persist beyond the window.
The VLM prefill and the expert are each compiled into a single CUDA graph.
With two 256 × 256 256{\times}256 images and a chunk of ten actions, REKI predicts a chunk in 21.8 ms on one H100 at K = 3 K\mkern 1.25mu{=}\mkern 1.25mu3 , the lowest latency among the VLAs compared in Section 6.3 .
In the measurement of Fig. 5 , the VLM prefill takes 9.5 ms and the Euler steps 8.1 ms, and reading the cached registers adds 0.1 ms.

blocks.en: 5.1 Pretraining data
blocks.zh: 5.1 预训数据

blocks.en:
Robot manipulation. We train on a broad mixture of public teleoperation datasets: RoboSet ( Bharadhwaj et al., 2024 ) , Galaxea ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , AgiBot World 2026 ( AgiBot World Team, 2026 ) , RoboCOIN ( Wu et al., 2025b ) , RoboMIND ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , RDT-1B ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) , BridgeData V2 ( Walke et al., 2023 ) , and twelve datasets of Open X-Embodiment ( Open X-Embodiment Collaboration, 2024 ) including RT-1 ( Brohan et al., 2023 ) and BC-Z ( Jang et al., 2022 ) ( Section B.1 ), complemented by motion-planned simulation from InternData-A1 ( Tian et al., 2026 ) and GR00T-X-Embodiment-Sim ( Bjorck et al., 2025 ) and bimanual YAM demonstrations from ABC ( Allshire et al., 2026 ) .
These span single-arm, bimanual, mobile, and humanoid platforms across tabletop, in-the-wild, and loco-manipulation settings (Appendix Table 1 ).
Action and state dimensions, control conventions and units vary across sources, and a robot may appear under several conventions.
Following Qwen-VLA ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , we keep each dataset’s native control convention rather than remapping to a shared action space, normalise each action dimension to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] by per-dataset quantiles, and zero-pad actions to a common width under a loss mask.
States are absolute, actions are absolute joint positions or delta end-effector poses, and rotations are harmonised to one Euler parameterisation.
The prompt and the per-layout state projections of Section 3.2 tell the policy which convention a sample follows.
In the spirit of Qwen-RobotManip’s multi-stage filtering ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , we curate every source before training: we keep only the degrees of freedom the policy commands, discard static and near-zero-variance episodes, and correct per-dataset sign conventions. Section B.2 gives the curation stages and the action representation.

blocks.en:
Egocentric human manipulation. We add three egocentric human manipulation datasets, EgoDex ( Hoque et al., 2026 ) , EgoVerse ( Punamiya et al., 2026 ) and Xperience ( Ropedia, 2026 ) , recorded from head-mounted or hand-held cameras.
They contribute ∼ 350 {\sim}350 k episodes and 170M frames.
The action target follows Qwen-VLA’s 32D bimanual layout ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , wrist motion and hand articulation per hand, here with the wrist expressed in the camera frame; no proprioceptive state is used, and each is resampled to the pace of robot teleoperation ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Section B.4 gives the sources, target definition and resampling.

Vision–language data. We train on the FineVision ( Wiedmann et al., 2025 ) and LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 ( An et al., 2025 ) datasets most relevant for spatial reasoning ( Section B.5 ), as well as targeted spatial-grounding and pointing corpora: RoboPoint ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , RefSpatial ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and PixMo ( Deitke et al., 2025 ) .
This auxiliary supervision preserves the backbone’s perception and spatial reasoning, and is mixed in at a small ratio with the robot and egocentric data.

blocks.en: 5.2 Models
blocks.zh: 5.2 模式

blocks.en:
REKI pairs the Qwen3.5-2B vision–language backbone with an action expert of 10 blocks of width 768, 32 registers per frame and a memory window of K = 3 K\mkern 1.25mu{=}\mkern 1.25mu3 frames.
It is pretrained on the mixture above for 200k steps on 32 H100 GPUs with a global batch of 2,880 samples, then finetuned on each benchmark separately.
The backbone is trained at 0.1 × 0.1\times the learning rate of the expert, and 10% of the training samples are vision–language data.
Finetuning steps, node counts and the number of evaluation rollouts per task are in Appendix Table 3 , the remaining hyperparameters in Appendix Table 2 .

blocks.en: 5.3 Visual data augmentation
blocks.zh: 5.3 视觉数据增强

blocks.en:
We apply data augmentation to make the model robust to visual variations: colour jittering, mild random cropping, random camera dropout and shuffled camera order.
When finetuning on RoboTwin, RoboCasa365 and RoboCasa-GR1, we add a mirroring augmentation, which extends the horizontal flip common in image classification to robot data.
With probability 0.5, a sample is replaced by its left-right mirror image.
The images are flipped, the state and the actions are reflected through the same plane, the arms of a two-arm robot are swapped, and the prompt marks the sample as mirrored ( Section C.2 ).
The augmentations and other training settings, such as the state dropout rate, have a large effect on robustness: on LIBERO-Plus, disabling camera dropout or the image augmentations lowers the success under camera-viewpoint changes by more than 20 points, and disabling state dropout lowers the success under changes of the initial robot state by 8.1 points ( Section D.2 ).

在对RoboTwin,RoboCasa365和RoboCasa-GR1进行微调时,我们增加了一个镜像增强,将图像分类中常见的横向翻转扩展至机器人数据.
以概率为0.5,一个样本被取而代之的是它的左-右镜相像.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6个实验

blocks.en: 6.1 Results
blocks.zh: 6.1 结果

blocks.en:
Benchmarks. LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023a ) has four suites of ten single-arm tabletop tasks, and LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) perturbs its 40 tasks along seven dimensions, from the camera viewpoint and the initial robot state to lighting and object layout.
The models are finetuned on the four suites and evaluated on both.
RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025b ) has 50 tasks on the dual-arm AgileX ALOHA, in clean scenes and in scenes with a randomised background, lighting, clutter and table height.
For the out-of-distribution evaluation (Clean2Rand; Yuan et al., 2026 ), the models are finetuned on clean scenes only and evaluated under six conditions: on clean scenes (Easy), under each randomisation alone and under all four together (Hard).
The Clean2Rand score is the mean over these six conditions.
RoboCasa365 ( Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) has kitchen tasks for a Franka arm on a mobile base.
The models are trained on the human demonstrations of its 300 pretraining tasks and evaluated on 50 target tasks: 18 atomic tasks, 16 composite tasks seen in training and 16 composite tasks unseen in training.
RoboCasa-GR1 ( Bjorck et al., 2025 ) has 24 tabletop tasks for the Fourier GR-1 humanoid, with 1000 demonstrations per task.
We compare mainly with VLAs of similar complexity, which pair a VLM with an action expert, such as π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , GR00T, ABot-M0 and InternVLA-A1.5.
As a gauge of the current upper bound on these benchmarks, we also report larger models pretrained on in-house data, Qwen-RobotManip, RLDX-1 and Xiaomi-Robotics-1, and the world-action model ABot-M0.5, built on a video generation model.
They are trained under different conditions, with more or proprietary data or a video model, so they are a reference rather than a like-for-like comparison. Figure 4 summarises the results across benchmarks, and Appendix Tables 4 , 5 and 6 list them in full.

对于分配外评价(Clean2Rand;Yuan等,2026年),模型只在清洁场景上进行微调,并在以下6个条件下进行评估:在清洁场景上(Easy),在每次随机化下单独进行并全部4个一起进行(Hard).
Clean2Rand的得分是这六个条件的取向.

作为衡量目前这些基准的上限值的尺度,我们还报告在内部数据上预先训练出更大的模型,Quen-RobotManip,RLDX-1和Xiaomi-Robotics-1,以及基于视频生成模型的世界行动模型ABot-M0.5.

blocks.en:
Out of distribution. REKI stands out most when the test conditions differ from training.
On LIBERO-Plus and Clean2Rand, it ranks first among the VLAs pretrained on public data, despite having the fewest parameters (2.4B, Figs. 4 and 4 ).
It leads the next of these models by 5.6 points on LIBERO-Plus (InternVLA-A1.5, 84.8) and by 10.1 points on Clean2Rand (ABot-M0, 55.7).
On the composite tasks of RoboCasa365 unseen in training, it is on par with Qwen-RobotManip (14.1 against 14.9) and behind Xiaomi-Robotics-1 (32.1), both larger and pretrained on in-house data.
blocks.zh:
出分发出. 当测试条件与培训不同时,REKI最为突出.
在LIBERO-Plus和Clean2Rand上,它虽然拥有最少的参数(2.4B,图4和图4),但在预先接受公共数据培训的VLA中排名第一.
它在LIBERO-Plus(InternVLA-A1.5,84.8)和Clean2Rand(ABot-M0,55.7)上以5.6分领先这些型号.
在培训中未见的RoboCasa365综合任务方面,它与Quen-RobotManip(14.1对14.9)和Xiaomi-Robotics-1(32.1)的后两者都处于同等地位,两者都比较大,并预先接受内部数据培训。

blocks.en:
In distribution. When trained and evaluated on the same tasks, REKI is competitive with larger models.
On RoboCasa365, it reaches 38.4, ahead of the larger RLDX-1 (36.0) and Qwen-RobotManip (35.9), both pretrained on in-house data ( Fig. 4 ), and on RoboCasa-GR1 it reaches 58.6, on par with the larger RLDX-1 (58.7) and ABot-M0 (58.3) ( Fig. 4 ).
On LIBERO, it reaches 97.5, where most models lie between 97.6 and 99.4.
REKI is weakest on RoboTwin, where it reaches 85.9 and 84.6, below the similarly sized InternVLA-A1.5 (93.3 / 93.0), which is supervised by an additional video generation model during training and uses a more complex, multi-stage pretraining ( Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
在分布. 在接受相同任务的培训和评价时,REKI与更大的模型具有竞争力.
在RoboCasa365上,它比较大的RLDX-1(36.0)和Quen-RobotManip(35.9)提前达到38.4分;在RoboCasa-GR1上,它比较大的RLDX-1(58.7分)和ABot-M0(58.3)(图4分)达到58.6分。
在LIBERO上,它达到了97.5,大多数型号位于97.6到99.4之间.
REKI在RoboTwin上最弱,达到85.9和84.6分,低于相类似大小的InternVLA-A1.5(93.3/93.0分),在训练期间由额外的视频生成模型监督,并使用更复杂的多阶段预训(图4).

blocks.en:
Pretraining gains. Trained from scratch on each benchmark, REKI reaches 52.0 on Clean2Rand, on par with Qwen-RobotManip (52.3) and ahead of StarVLA (36.6), which both have larger VLMs (4.5B and 4.4B).
REKI is ahead of both under the Hard condition (26.3 against 22.6 and 10.6).
On LIBERO-Plus it leads with 86.1, ahead of Qwen-RobotManip (78.3) and StarVLA (75.0).
Pretraining on public data benefits REKI most out of distribution, and in particular under the RoboTwin randomisations (Appendix Tables 5 and 4 ).
In distribution, it adds 2.9 and 0.8 points on RoboTwin and 1.0 on LIBERO.
Out of distribution, it adds 13.8 points on Clean2Rand and 4.3 on LIBERO-Plus, and the gain grows where REKI without pretraining fails most, with 30.3 points under clutter and 22.4 under the Hard condition.
On LIBERO-Plus, the gain is also largest under perturbed robot states (11.7).
blocks.zh:
预训增益. REKI从零开始在每个基准上训练,在Clean2Rand上达到52.0分,与Quen-RobotManip(52.3分)和StarVLA(36.6)相同,两者都具有更大的VLM(4.5B分和4.4B分).
在困难条件下,REKI领先于两者(26.3对22.6和10.6)。
在LIBERO-Plus上,它以86.1领先于Quen-RobotManip (78.3)和StarVLA (75.
公共数据预先培训对REKI的惠益大多不在分发范围,特别是在RoboTwin随机化下(附录表5和表4)。
在发售中,它在RoboTwin上增加了2.9分和0.8分,在LIBERO上增加了1.0分.
在分发中,它增加了Clean2Rand的13.8分和LIBERO-Plus的4.3分,在没有预训的REKI失败最多的地方,收益会增加,在Clutter下为30.3分,在Hard下为22.4分.
在LIBERO-Plus上,在被扰动的机器人状态下收益也最大(11.7).

blocks.en:
Additional data or supervision. REKI is outperformed by several larger and more recent models that add data or supervision to the vanilla recipe, with large in-house data collections ( Xiaomi Robotics Team, 2026 ) or video generation models ( Song et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Similarly, InternVLA-A1.5 uses the same VLM as REKI, with an additional video generation model, a larger action expert (24 layers vs 10 for REKI) and a multi-stage pretraining, and is ahead in distribution on RoboTwin (93.3 vs 85.9).
Out of distribution, it is behind on LIBERO-Plus (84.8 vs 90.4).
Qwen-RobotManip, pretrained with additional synthetic data, gains more from pretraining than REKI (16.2 vs 13.8 points on Clean2Rand).
REKI reaches its lead out of distribution without such additions, and we expect it to benefit similarly from additional data, be it real ( Xiaomi Robotics Team, 2026 ) , synthetic ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) or generated by a world model ( Kim et al., 2026 ; GigaBrain Team et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
补充数据或监督。 REKI的性能被几个更大的更近期的模型所超越,这些模型在香草食谱上添加了数据或监督,拥有大型的内部数据收集(小米机器人团队,2026年)或视频生成模型(宋等,2026年;张等,2026年).
同样地,InternVLA-A1.5也采用了与REKI相同的VLM,增加了一个视频生成模型,一个更大的动作专家(24层对10为REKI)和一个多阶段预训,并在RoboTwin(93.3 vs 85.9)上提前发售.
在LIBERO-Plus上(84.8 vs 90.4)的发行量不足。
Quen-RobotManip,通过附加合成数据进行预训,比REKI(16.2 vs 13.8 point on Clean2Rand)获得更多的预训收益.
REKI在没有这种添加的情况下运出其发行量的铅,我们期望它同样受益于额外数据,无论是真实的(小米机器人团队,2026年),合成的(袁等,2026年),还是由世界模型产生的(金等,2026年;GigaBrain). Team等,2026 (英语).

blocks.en:
Memory window. Figure 5 varies the memory window of REKI at finetuning and at evaluation, on LIBERO-Plus after finetuning on LIBERO, on RoboTwin Clean and on RoboCasa365.
Finetuned and evaluated with three frames ( 3 → 3 3\to 3 ), REKI reaches 90.4 on LIBERO-Plus, 73.4 on RoboTwin and 38.4 on RoboCasa365, against 88.9, 67.9 and 33.0 without memory ( 1 → 1 1\to 1 ).
Most of the gain already comes with the first past frame ( 3 → 2 3\to 2 : 90.1, 73.6 and 39.3).
As every frame of a training window is supervised ( Eq. 6 ), the model finetuned with memory also learns to act without it.
Evaluated without memory ( 3 → 1 3\to 1 ), it performs close to the model finetuned at K = 1 K\mkern 1.25mu{=}\mkern 1.25mu1 (88.9, 67.2 and 34.9), so the gain comes mainly from reading the past frames at inference, not from training on windows.

Oscillation. For each arm, we compare how it moves during one chunk with how it moved during the previous one, ignoring small movements. Figure 5 counts the episodes in which an arm moves in roughly the opposite direction at three or more consecutive chunks, that is, it goes back and forth at least twice ( Fig. 7 ).
We set this criterion on 16 of the 50 tasks and confirmed the effect of memory on the other 34.
Fewer than 5% of these episodes succeed.
With the same weights, removing the past frames at evaluation raises their share from 4.1% to 14.8%, and one past frame already brings it down to 4.6%.
Trained without memory, REKI oscillates in 18.6% of the episodes, and in half of those that fail.
The difference is largest in two-arm tasks ( Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh:
O. 对于每一只手臂,我们比较它在一个块的移动方式与它上个块的移动方式,忽略了小的移动方式. 图5计算了手臂在相接的3个或3个以上的相接点上大致相反方向移动的几起事件,即至少前后两次相接(图7).
我们为50项任务中的16项设定了这一标准,并确认了记忆对其他34项任务的影响。
其中成功率不到5%.
用同样的权重,去掉过去评价时的帧将份额从4.1%提高到14.8%,一个过去的帧已经将其降到了4.6%.
在没有记忆的训练中,REKI在18.6%的剧集中和失败的剧集中一半都振荡.
在双臂任务(图5)中差异最大.

blocks.en:
Why memory helps. A policy without memory maps the current observation to the next chunk.
If two poses A and B each look like demonstration states that continue towards the other, the chunk predicted at A leads to B, and the chunk predicted at B leads back to A. We attribute the oscillation to this form of perceptual aliasing, under which memoryless policies are known to fail ( Whitehead & Ballard, 1991 ; Singh et al., 1994 ; McCallum, 1996 ) .
A short history resolves the ambiguity, since a window that has just come from B does not match demonstrations that move towards B. In two-arm tasks, the most frequent cycle is an arm swap, in which one arm reaches while the other retracts (65 against 1 of 1000 episodes without and with memory, top row of Fig. 7 ). It typically starts a few seconds after a release.
Memory does not rescue all these episodes: where the policy without memory oscillates, the policy with memory succeeds on 45% of the seeds.
blocks.zh:
为什么记忆有帮助。 一个没有内存的政策将当前观测图映射到下一个块 。
如果两个构成A和B的每个看起来都像向另一个延伸的演示状态,那么A预测的块会通向B,而B预测的块会通向A。 我们把振荡归因于这种认知化名形式,根据这种形式,无记忆政策已知失败(Whitehead & Ballard,1991年;Singh等人,1994年;McCallum,1996年)。
短暂的历史解决了含糊不清的问题,因为刚刚从B产生的窗口与走向B的示威并不匹配。 在双臂任务中,最经常的循环是手臂相换,其中一臂相接而另一臂相接而倒置(65对1000个相中1个相接而无并有记忆,上行为图. 7. 通常在发布后几秒钟开始.
记忆并不能挽救所有这些事件:当没有记忆的策略会振荡时,带有记忆的策略会在45%的种子上获得成功.

blocks.en:
Protocol. We measure the latency of one call, from the raw observation to the unnormalised actions of one chunk, including preprocessing and the transfers between host and device.
This latency bounds how quickly a policy can react to a new observation and how often it can replan, whatever the number of actions it predicts.
In practice, policies replan well before the end of a long chunk, typically in under a second, since executing more actions open loop makes them slower to react ( Black et al., 2024 ; Chi et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) .
Each model predicts one chunk from two 256 × 256 256{\times}256 images ( 128 × 128 128{\times}128 for ABot-M0.5), the robot state and a fixed prompt, at batch size one, with its released checkpoint and inference code.
Each value in Fig. 6 is the median over 320 chunks (80 for ABot-M0.5) and three repetitions, each on its own GPU of a node reserved for the timing ( Section D.4 ).
blocks.zh:
议定书。 我们测量一个呼叫的暂时性,从原始观察到一个块的非正常动作,包括预处理和主机与设备之间的转移.
这决定了一项政策能够对新的观察作出反应的速度,以及它能够重新规划的次数,无论它预测的行动数量如何。
在实践中,政策远在一长块结束之前就重新制定,通常在一秒之内,因为执行更多的行动公开循环使其反应速度更慢(Black等,2024;Chi等,2025;Liu等,2024b)。
每个模型从两个256×256\256\times}256的图像(ABot-M0.5的128×128\times}128)中预测出一个块,机器人状态和一个固定的即时器,分批大小为一,带有其释放的检查站和推断代码.
每个值在Fig。 6是中位数超过320个块(80个为ABot-M0.5)和3个重复,每个重复都是在自己为计时预留的节点的GPU上(D.4节.

blocks.en:
Compilation. Most of the compared models are released without a compiled path, or with one that can be further optimised.
Without compilation, all models are slow ( Fig. 6 , left): REKI, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} with openpi ( Physical Intelligence, 2025 ) and ABot-M0 ( Yang et al., 2026 ) take 118 to 139 ms per chunk, InternVLA-A1.5 ( Ma et al., 2026 ) 352 ms, and X-VLA (0.9B; Zheng et al., 2025 ) 51 ms.
In most of these runs, the GPU is busy less than half of the time, so compiling the prediction, which removes most of the host time, makes it two to seven times faster ( Fig. 6 , right).
We compile REKI entirely into CUDA graphs, including its memory ( Section A.1 ).
For a fair comparison, we also compile X-VLA, ABot-M0, InternVLA-A1.5 and ABot-M0.5 ( Chen et al., 2026 ) without changing their computation, and report both their released path and ours.
blocks.zh:
汇编. 大多数被比较的模型发布时都没有编译出路径,或者有一个可以被进一步优化的路径.
没有编译,所有型号都比较慢(图6,左):REKI, ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5) 有openpi (物理智能, 2025年) 和 ABot-M0 (Yang等, 2026年) 每块需要118至139 ms, InternVLA-A1.5 (Ma等, 2026年) 352 ms, 和 X-VLA (0.9 B; 郑等, 2025年) 51 ms.
在这些跑步中,GPU忙得不到一半的时间,因此将预测编译出,从而去除了大部分主机时间,使得它的速度快了2到7倍(图6,右).
我们完全将REKI编成CUDA图表,包括其内存(A.1节)。
为了进行公平的比较,我们还汇编了X-VLA、ABot-M0、InternVLA-A1.5和ABot-M0.5(Chen等,2026年),而不改变计算方式,并报告其释放的路径和我们的路径。

blocks.en:
Results. With compilation, REKI is the fastest of the compared models ( Fig. 6 , right): it predicts a chunk in 21.8 ms, against 25.5 ms for X-VLA, 33.8 ms for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} with openpi, 46.1 ms for ABot-M0 and 51.3 ms for InternVLA-A1.5.
Its GPU time per chunk, 16.5 ms, is on par with that of X-VLA (16.1 ms) and below that of the other models, which need at least 25.3 ms.
InternVLA-A1.5 uses the same VLM as REKI, and the difference lies in its action expert, which runs at each of the ten Euler steps: with 0.5B parameters in 24 layers against 0.2B in 10, its Euler steps take 34.9 ms against 8.2 ms for REKI (Appendix Table 10 ).
ABot-M0.5 generates future video latents before it predicts actions, and takes 2.7 s per chunk without compilation and 1.4 s with the CUDA graphs that we built.

Tasks and protocol. We evaluate performance across five manipulation tasks, and report task success rates and partial subtask success rates.
Tasks span diverse action primitives, including pick, place, stack, and sweep.
The tasks and partial success scores are defined in Appendix E .
We collect 50 training episodes per task with a Meta Quest controller, and evaluate on 10 test episodes per task, with randomised initial object placements and distractors in each episode.

The action chunk has 50 steps (3.3 s) for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , fixed by its pretraining, and 30 steps (2 s) for REKI.
In both models, only the last four vision encoder blocks are trained.
The backbone is trained at 0.1 × 0.1\times the learning rate of the action expert.
REKI is finetuned with a memory window of K = 3 K\mkern 1.25mu{=}\mkern 1.25mu3 and without memory ( K = 1 K\mkern 1.25mu{=}\mkern 1.25mu1 ). π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} has no memory.

Results. Across the five tasks, REKI outperforms π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} by 7 to 37.5 percentage points ( Fig. 8 , right).
Removing the memory leaves performance on the shorter-horizon tasks mainly unchanged (65 against 65 and 57.5 against 57.5), but consistently degrades it on the longer-horizon tasks, where REKI outperforms its memoryless variant by 12 to 17.5 percentage points, supporting that memory matters most when tasks require tracking progress over many steps.
For qualitative examples, see Fig. 12 .

blocks.en:
A vanilla VLA. REKI follows a standard VLA recipe: a VLM’s last hidden states are read by a flow-matching action expert, pretrained in a single stage on public robot, egocentric human and vision–language data, and then finetuned on each benchmark.
It uses no proprietary data ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 , cf.) , no world model ( Chen et al., 2026 , cf.) and no additional training stages.
Even so, it can compete with, and often outperform, VLAs of similar size pretrained on in-house data, and it leads the compared VLAs pretrained on public data out of distribution ( Fig. 4 ), where pretraining adds 13.8 points on Clean2Rand and 4.3 on LIBERO-Plus ( Section 6.1 ).
Many of the strongest entries on current leaderboards take the other route: they are world-action models built on video generation models ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2026 ) or VLAs pretrained on large proprietary data ( Xiaomi Robotics Team, 2026 ; GigaBrain Team et al., 2026 ) .
These models set the current state of the art, but they can be costly to run ( Section 6.3 ).
Their pretraining is also hard to reproduce, which makes it difficult to separate the effects of data scale, model size, modelling choices and additional supervision such as world modelling.
We intend REKI to serve as an open reference on which each of these factors can be tested in isolation.
blocks.zh:
一个香草VLA。 REKI遵循一个标准的VLA配方:一个VLM的最后一个隐藏状态由流相匹配动作专家读取,在公共机器人的单一阶段进行预训,以自我为中心的人和视觉语言数据,然后在每个基准上微调.
它没有使用专有数据(袁等,2026;金等,2026;参见.),没有世界模式(陈等,2026;参见.
即便如此,它也可以与类似规模的VLA进行竞争,而且往往比在内部数据上预先训练的VLA还要好,它导致比较的VLA在公共数据上预先训练的出发(图4),其中预训在Clean2Rand和LIBERO-Plus上增加了13.8分(第6.1节).
现时领导板上许多最强的条目采用其他路线:它们是以视频生成模型为基础的世界行动模型(Chen等,2026;Wang等,2026b; 张等, 2026; Song等, 2026)或VLAs在大专有数据上预训(小米机器人队, 2026; GigaBrain) Team等,2026 (英语).
这些模型设定了目前的工艺状态,但运行成本可能很高(第6.3节.
他们的预训也很难被再现,这使得难以区分出数据尺度,模型大小,建模选择和世界建模等额外监督的效果.
我们打算把可再生能源基础设施作为开放的参考,以孤立地检验其中的每一个因素。

blocks.en:
An efficient open baseline. We release REKI with its full pipeline, from data curation to deployment, and the checkpoints of every benchmark, so that new architectures, data mixtures or training objectives can be pretrained and compared against it under fixed conditions.
The simplicity of the recipe and the efficiency of the code keep such comparisons affordable: finetuning REKI takes 8 H100 GPU-hours on our real-robot tasks and 40 to 400 on the benchmarks ( Tables 11 and 3 ).
The memory adds no cost at training ( Section 4.2 ) and less than 1% of the inference time, so REKI is an efficient starting point for studying memory in embodied AI.
In the released code, REKI runs entirely as CUDA graphs, memory included, and predicts an action chunk from the LIBERO inputs in 21.8 ms on one H100.
It stays the fastest of the compared models even when their released code is compiled ( Section 6.3 ).
blocks.zh:
高效的开放基线。 我们释放了REKI全程的管道,从数据整理到部署,以及每个基准的检查站,这样新的架构、数据混合物或培训目标就可以预先训练,并在固定条件下与之作比较。
简便的食谱和代码的效率使这种比较能够负担得起:微调REKI需要8个H100 GPU小时来完成我们的实际机器人任务,需要40至400小时的基准(表11和表3)。
内存在训练时不增加成本(第4.2节)并少于推断时间的1%,因此REKI在所体现AI中是研究内存的有效起点.
在发布的代码中,REKI完全作为CUDA图运行,包含内存,并预测从LIBERO输入到一个H100上的21.8 mss的动作块.
即使其发布的代码已经编译(第6.3节),它仍然是比较模型中最快的.

blocks.en:
Why inference speed matters. Inference speed matters not only at deployment, where it bounds how quickly a policy can react ( Section 6.3 ), but also for training.
VLAs are increasingly post-trained with reinforcement learning, in simulation ( Li et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Zang et al., 2026 ) or in learned world models ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Sharma et al., 2026 ) , where the policy is queried for every action chunk of every rollout, so that its inference time is multiplied across the whole training run.
At 21.8 ms per chunk, REKI offers a strong open starting point for such post-training and lowers the barrier to it, a step towards making it accessible beyond the few groups with large compute budgets.
blocks.zh:
为什么推论速度很重要。 推论速度不仅在部署时很重要,因为它限制政策的反应速度(第6.3节),而且对培训也很重要。
在模拟方面,志愿军越来越多地经过强化学习的培训(Li等,2025;Chen等,2025a); Zang等人,2026年)或学习世界模型(Zhu等人,2025年;Sharma等人,2026年),其中对每次推出的每个行动都询问政策,以便其推论时间在整个培训过程中倍增。
REKI每块21.8 ms,为这种培训后提供了一个强有力的开放起点,并降低了培训障碍,这是在为数不多的计算预算较高的群体之外,使培训无障碍的一个步骤。

blocks.en:
Memory. In REKI, a few register tokens in the action expert summarise each frame and stay in the expert’s cache, so the VLM still sees each frame only once.
Even this short memory helps: with three frames, success rises by 1.5 to 5.5 points on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin and RoboCasa365, and by 12 to 17.5 points on the longer real-robot tasks.
Most of the gain comes from a single past frame, which in particular reduces repetitive oscillations between two poses, suggesting that a little temporal context is enough to tell apart observations that look alike ( Section 6.2 ).
A memory of a few seconds therefore appears sufficient for most tasks in standard benchmarks.
Whether the registers can also carry the much longer context of tasks that depend on events far in the past remains to be tested.
blocks.zh:
记忆. 在 REKI 中, 动作专家中的一些注册符文概括每个帧并保留在专家的缓存中, 所以 VLM 仍然只看到每个帧一次 。
就连这个短记忆也有帮助:用三帧,成功在LIBERO-Plus,RoboTwin和RoboCasa365上提升了1.5至5.5分,在更长的真机器人任务上提升了12至17.5分.
大部分收益来自一个单一的过去框架,这尤其能减少两个姿势之间的重复振荡,说明一个小的时间背景就足以分辨出看起来相似的分辨(第6.2节).
因此,在标准基准中,几秒钟的记忆似乎足以完成大多数任务。
登记册是否还能够承担远视过去发生的事件而定的更长的任务,仍有待检验。

blocks.en: B.2 Data curation
blocks.zh: B.2 数据整理

blocks.en:
Aggregating data across embodiments, simulators, and collection pipelines introduces heterogeneous noise: sensor outliers, temporal state-action misalignment, and inconsistent conventions across datasets sharing a robot. • Channel selection. We keep only the degrees of freedom the policy commands, dropping derived or uncontrolled channels: forward-kinematic end-effector poses, joint velocities, efforts, IMU readings, and telepresence-parked head, waist, and leg joints. • Degenerate episodes. We discard static and near-zero-variance recordings, including episodes whose follower arm never moves, a failure mode Qwen-RobotManip reports for ∼ 81 % {\sim}81\% of RoboMIND’s UR subset. • Sudden jumps. We fit a smooth trend to each channel with median and Savitzky–Golay filters, and flag a frame when its residual and its acceleration or jerk exceed a per-channel threshold, the larger of 0.05 in raw units and four times the pooled 95th percentile.
Grippers are exempt.
Whole episodes are removed only from InternData-A1, where simulator collisions cause the jumps (6.3% of its episodes). • Action representation. Rotations are harmonised to one Euler parameterisation; other conventions are kept as the source provides them.
Each action dimension is mapped to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] from its per-dataset 1st and 99th percentiles ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , which removes scale differences across embodiments while preserving relative motion within each source. • Convention correction. We fix per-dataset sign conventions that would otherwise break cross-dataset consistency ( e.g. , a sign-flipped elbow joint in InternData); differing scales and encodings are then absorbed by the per-dataset normalisation.

blocks.en:
Sources. The three egocentric sources differ in capture conditions: EgoDex is seated tabletop recordings on Apple Vision Pro, EgoVerse head-mounted rigs, and Xperience in-the-wild moving-camera footage.

blocks.en:

Unlike Qwen-VLA, which expresses the wrist relative to its own initial pose, we express it in the observation camera frame through the rigid transform T cam − 1 ​ T wrist T_{\mathrm{cam}}^{-1}T_{\mathrm{wrist}} .
The articulation coefficients are the first 10 principal components (“eigengrasps”) of the finger-joint configuration under a PCA basis shared across our three sources.
The target is defined relative to the frame that opens each action chunk, so it is composed at load time from the stored world-frame wrist poses and per-frame camera poses rather than precomputed.

blocks.en:
REKI is co-trained on vision–language data at 10% of the training samples ( Table 2 ).
The pool is every FineVision ( Wiedmann et al., 2025 ) dataset except the text-only ones, plus the LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 ( An et al., 2025 ) datasets that FineVision does not already contain, ∼ 20.2 {\sim}20.2 M samples.
We keep the datasets covering the tasks most relevant to manipulation: natural-scene objects and attributes, spatial relations, counting, grounding, captioning, scene text, and knowledge and commonsense VQA.
Documents, charts, tables, mathematics, code, transcription, GUI grounding, memes and puzzles are dropped. 60 datasets remain, 7.64M samples or 37.8% of the pool.
One question–answer pair is drawn per sample and sampling is uniform over samples, so exposure is proportional to the size of a dataset.

blocks.en: C.1 Camera selection
blocks.zh: C.1 相机选择

blocks.en:
In pretraining, two rules remove cameras from a sample after the random camera dropout.
When two or more side cameras remain, one of them is kept at random and the others are removed.
On a two-arm robot with both wrist cameras present, the wrist camera of a static arm is removed.
An arm is static when, over the action chunk, every action dimension of the arm varies by less than 0.1 0.1 of its standard deviation in the dataset.
Both rules keep at least one camera other than the overhead camera.
Finetuning uses neither rule.
Random camera dropout never removes the overhead camera, except in LIBERO finetuning ( Table 3 ).
blocks.zh:
在预训中,有两项规则在随机相机停放后从样本中去除相机.
当两相机或多相机留存后,其中一相机随机保存并取出其他相机.
在两个手腕相机都存在的双臂机器人上,静臂的手腕相机被取出.
当在动作块上,臂的每个动作维度在数据集中相差不到标准偏差0.1分时,臂是静态的.
这两项规则都至少保留了一台相机,但机上相机除外.
微调不使用规则。
除了LIBERO的微调(表3)之外,随机相机的停放从来不去掉起落相机。

blocks.en: C.2 Mirroring
blocks.zh: C.2 镜像

blocks.en:
A sample is mirrored with probability 0.5 0.5 in the finetuning runs on RoboTwin, RoboCasa365 and RoboCasa-GR1 ( Table 3 ).
The images are flipped horizontally, and the state and the actions are reflected through the same plane.
On a two-arm robot, the two arms and their wrist cameras are swapped.
The prompt of a mirrored sample starts with [MIRROR WORLD] , and its state goes through a separate projection with separate normalisation statistics.
The policy is evaluated in the unmirrored world only.
blocks.zh:
在RoboTwin、RoboCasa365和RoboCasa-GR1(表3)的微调中,一个样本的概率为0.5。
图像横向翻转,状态和动作通过同平面反射.
在两臂机器人上,双臂和手腕相机被互换.
镜像样本的提示从[MIRROR WORLD]开始,其状态通过单独的投影,并有单独的正常化统计.
这项政策只在没有印象的世界中进行评估。

blocks.en:
Mirroring. On RoboCasa365, mirroring ( Section C.2 ) adds 4.9 points on average, mostly on the atomic tasks ( + 6.2 +6.2 ) and the seen composite tasks ( + 7.9 +7.9 ).
On LIBERO-Plus, mirroring improves four of the seven perturbation dimensions, by 0.2 0.2 to 1.7 1.7 points.
However, it lowers the camera dimension by 6.5 6.5 points, so the overall score drops by 0.6 0.6 .
A possible explanation is that the policy infers whether the world is mirrored from the images as well as from the prompt.
A large change of the camera viewpoint may then confuse the policy about whether the world is mirrored.
blocks.zh:
镜相相相. 在RoboCasa365上,镜像(C.2节)平均增加了4.9分,主要是原子任务(+6.2+6.2)和所见复合任务(+7.9+7.9).
在LIBERO-Plus上,镜像改进了7个扰动维度中的4个,提高了0.2到1.71.7分.
然而,它将相机维度降低了6.5分,因此总分下降了0.6分.
一个可能的解释是,政策推断世界是否从图像中以及从瞬间中反映出来。
相机观点的大幅改变可能会混淆关于世界是否被镜像的政策.

blocks.en:
Visual augmentation. Disabling camera dropout or the image augmentations (colour jittering and random cropping) causes a large drop on the camera dimension of LIBERO-Plus, by 21.5 21.5 and 23.6 23.6 points.
This suggests that these augmentations make the policy robust to changes of the camera viewpoint.
They also give a small gain on the sensor noise and object layout dimensions, of 1.6 1.6 to 4.6 4.6 points.
For camera dropout, a likely reason is the wrist camera: the policy is trained to act from the wrist image alone, and the camera and sensor-noise perturbations of LIBERO-Plus change only the image of the external camera ( Fei et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: D.4 Inference latency of the compared methods
blocks.zh: D.4 联合国 比较方法的推论性

blocks.en:
In Section 6.3 , each model is timed with its released checkpoint and inference code on one H100 (driver 570, CUDA 12.8), one model per process, at batch size one.
The observations are synthetic and seeded, with new images and state at every chunk.
In the LIBERO setting, each model receives two 256 × 256 256{\times}256 images, an 8-D state and a fixed prompt, and applies its own resizing and tokenisation.
Each repetition is one warm-up episode followed by 320 timed chunks, and runs as a separate job on its own GPU of a node reserved for the timing.
ABot-M0.5 takes several seconds per chunk, so each of its repetitions times 80 chunks, in four episodes of 20.
The end-to-end time runs from the numpy observation to the unnormalised numpy actions.
The model time starts from preprocessed tensors on the device, and the GPU time sums the CUDA kernel durations of a chunk, from a profiler pass taken last in the process.
Eager runs use inference mode where the released code does, and fp32 runs enable TF32, as the LeRobot evaluation ( Cadene et al., 2024 ) does.
Every run has to load the released weights strictly, return finite actions of the right shape that change with the input, and keep at least 95% of them within the action range of the checkpoint.
The official compiled path of InternVLA-A1.5 is slower than eager, and its optimized path returns non-finite actions after the first chunk, which we avoid by keeping one autocast context open for the whole process.
For X-VLA, ABot-M0, InternVLA-A1.5 and ABot-M0.5, we also build a compiled path over the released code, without changing the computation.
These runs show what the models can reach, not what their users get.
The phase times of REKI and InternVLA-A1.5 in Section 6.3 come from a separate run on one exclusive node ( Table 10 ).

观测结果是合成的和种子的,每块都有新的图像和状态。
在LIBERO设定中,每个型号都接收到2个256×256\256\times}256个相片,一个8-D状态和一个固定的快取,并应用了自己的再大小和标识.
每一次重复都是一集热身,后有320个定时块,并作为单独的工作运行在自己为定时预留的节点的GPU上.
ABot-M0.5每块需要数秒,所以每次重复为80个块,分四集为20个.
端到端的时间从numby观察到非正态的numby动作.

blocks.en: E.1 Tasks and scoring

blocks.en:
We evaluate on five tasks.
Partial credit is awarded for each completed subtask, such as a successful grasp or placement.
For tasks with an imposed ordering, a penalty is applied when objects are handled in the wrong order.
An episode counts as a full success only when every subtask is completed in the correct order.
The first two tasks involve a single object and are shorter-horizon.
The remaining three require manipulating two or three objects in a prescribed order, so the policy must keep track of which steps have already been completed.

一个剧集只有在每一个子任务按正确的顺序完成时才会算作完全成功.
前两个任务涉及一个单一对象,是更短的视线.
其余3个则需要按规定的顺序来操纵2个或3个物体,因此政策必须跟踪已经完成的步骤.
